properties.name: Pune Municipal Corporation Candidate Boundary (Post-2021 Expansion)

provenance.originalSourceRelativePath: ndata/Pune City Data/PMC Wards Info/PMC Prabhag Boundary.kml
provenance.originalPublisher: Unknown (Likely PMC IT/GIS Cell or PSCDCL; unconfirmed by source metadata)
provenance.originalDownloadUrl: Unknown (not recorded in source file or repository)
provenance.delimitationEffectivePeriod: Post-July 2021 (incorporates all 23 peripheral villages merged under Maharashtra UDD Notification No. PMC-2020/CR-101/UD-22, June 30, 2021)
provenance.conversionMethod: Deterministic XML coordinate parse -> consecutive duplicate vertex deduplication -> 72-feature Turf union -> preservation of verified >= 1 ha interior exclusions (Mundhwa/Ghorpadi defense corridor) -> suppression of hairline seam slivers (< 1 ha)
provenance.legalAuthoritativeness: Non-authoritative candidate for renewable energy planning and spatial classification. Source provenance unconfirmed.
knownLimitations: Source dataset is an administrative prabhag partition rather than a certified cadastre boundary.
Feature 71 (Pune Station) possessed duplicate objectid=17 and omitted SDE attribute fields in original KML.
Feature 71 covers the central railway corridor and Pune Cantonment envelope, which is an independent military municipality excluded from municipal electoral wards.
Mundhwa Jackwell / Ghorpadi defense corridor (0.815 km²) is retained as an interior exclusion.
